Content & notices

ArrayStep · By Subahini Nadarajh · 0.1.0

Lessons, explanations, practice tasks, quizzes, code examples and the geometric app icon were created for this project with AI assistance. General algorithms and mathematical concepts are standard educational material. No external training dataset, EEG recording, examination paper, paid course, LeetCode problem statement, logo, submission or editorial is bundled.

Some problem names and optional links identify third-party LeetCode exercises. LeetCode is a third-party service; ArrayStep is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by it. External content remains subject to its provider’s terms. Availability of external problems is not guaranteed.

System fonts are used. No downloaded photographs, illustrations or external font files are bundled.

Native app dependencies

The packaged app uses Capacitor and the Capacitor Browser, Filesystem and Share plugins under their included open-source licenses. Exact versions are recorded in package-lock.json. Their license texts follow.
